crossRefs.note: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he…
Jehoash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately…
They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word…
Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came, and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed…

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

translations.web: Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
translations.bsb: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
translations.kjv: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
translations.asv: And Joash did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
